notes.title: Update Notes 03-30-25
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Here's a quick list of some changes made to the game:


New stealth mechanic introduced
New enemies introduced alongside new levels
New level environments introduced
New platform objects introduced
Enemy AI has been slightly refined


All five of these updates will be refined and inserted into the official game soon!

notes.title: Small Updates for 12-08-24
notes.content:
Reconfigured save system
 Added new animations
 Added autosave feature
 Fixed collisions bugs that would cause the player to float next to platforms
 Updated in-game dialogue
 Added new crouch walk mechanic
 Added an additional lo-fi track

notes.title: Updates Notes 02-03-2024
notes.content:
Similar to the Major Update notes for the main game, the changes made are as follows


 New artwork has been added.
Optimized performance by minimizing frames in animations.
 Adjusted the drone behavior, making it slightly less aggressive.
 Added new music to the game.
 Introduced a new enemy.


Any feedback from testers is welcome!

Thanks
